about: One implementation per design-system family (tool/ds-audit, category duplicate.<family>). `canonical` is the component new code uses; `deprecated` maps each duplicate widget or function to the file that declares it. Every reference to a deprecated name outside its own file is counted and ratcheted down in tool/ds-audit-baseline.json. A family with an empty `deprecated` map counts nothing; it records the canonical component only. `pending` marks a family whose canonical choice belongs to an open work package (no canonical, no deprecated names until it lands); `uncertain` records a canonical choice that still needs a decision (JSON has no comments, so these are fields); `note` explains the entry. Do not add a name to two families.

button.note: One RaftButton (raft/button.dart, Web Button + icon-* sizes). Every other button-like widget retires onto it.

menu.pending: P2 (menus and popovers) decides the single menu implementation (RaftDropdownMenu, RaftMenuPanel, RaftContextMenuContent, RaftSidebarContextMenu, RaftSelectionPopover and RaftMenuButtonItem are the candidates). Nothing is canonical or deprecated until it lands.
menu.note: Registered so the family is visible; it counts nothing yet.

popover.note: RaftAnchoredPopup places a popup (viewport collision, flip) and RaftPopoverSurface paints it: layers of one popover, not rivals, so neither is deprecated. Private OverlayPortal/OverlayEntry panels are covered by bypass.overlay.

dialog.uncertain: RaftFormDialog has many app callers and may be rebuilt on RaftDialog instead of removed; it is listed so no new callers appear.
dialog.note: RaftDialogSurface and RaftDialogBackdrop are shared paint and scrim parts; title, body, footer and positioning stay with the dialog family. Frozen compositions keep their existing renderers.

segmented.uncertain: The inventory names RaftSegmentedTrack + RaftSegmentedItem (raft/segmented_control.dart) as the Web-ported implementation and RaftSegmentedControl (design_primitives.dart) as a duplicate; RaftSegmentedControl is built on RaftSegmentedTrack today. Listed as requested; the surviving public API is not decided.

spinner.note: RaftSpinner is the single public spinner (P6). RaftPixelSpinner (raft/pixel_spinner.dart) is its internal painter for the pixel look, not a duplicate.

card.note: RaftRecipeCard, RaftSurfaceListItem and RaftChoiceCard were merged into RaftCard (P6) and no longer exist.

banner.note: RaftWarningBanner was removed (P6). RaftAgentBanner is a thin adapter over RaftBanner (maps status and passes colour overrides, styles nothing itself), so it is not a duplicate. RaftArchivedNameBanner was deferred by P6 on purpose: it builds its own box from the banner recipe. RaftBillingNotice and RaftPreviewNotice are not banners and are not listed.

list_row.note: List row duplicates; RaftListRow (raft/list_row.dart) is the Web ListRow port. RaftSurfaceListItem was merged into RaftCard (P6) and no longer exists.
